executed: Upgraded InventoryV2Module.luau to render a live 3D item preview in the inspect panel. Replaced the "[ 3D MODEL PREVIEW ]" placeholder TextLabel with a ViewportFrame ("ItemViewport") filling the same modelBox frame (no layout/overlap change). Added a module-level `createItemPreview(viewport)` function that builds a dummy gray rifle (7 gray/dark-gray Metal Parts: body, barrel, muzzle, stock, grip, magazine, sight) as a Model, adds a dedicated Camera (FOV 32, transparent background, positioned to frame the gun) plus key/fill PointLights so it is clearly visible, and starts a RunService.RenderStepped loop slowly rotating the model (~35 deg/s via PivotTo). The function returns a teardown closure that disconnects the RenderStepped connection and Destroys the model, camera, and both lights. Lifecycle is wired in Mount(): a Visible property-changed signal on the root CanvasGroup builds the preview when shown and tears it down when hidden (covers both the close "X" button and the B/Tab toggle in UIController, which flip root.Visible), and a Destroying signal tears it down on full GUI destruction — preventing memory leaks. Existing UI behavior (B toggle, layout, no overlap) is untouched.
